releaseNotes: v1.9.11: AWS Bedrock, four new provider lanes, and analytics that honour the selected window — AWS Bedrock runtime with SSO, SigV4 signing and hardened EventStream streaming (#249), the signer and credential resolution landing as their own reusable package (#264); new provider lanes for Kimi (Responses), Codex image generation, ElevenLabs Scribe STT and MiniMax Code credits (#251, #264); Cache Analytics and Compression Analytics now bind every card, breakdown and chart to one selected window through internal/analyticsrange, so “Last 24 hours” no longer shows all-time totals, and the reads behind them are indexed (#275); the dashboard was shipping an API key inside the bundle for the CLI tools — Pi, Oh My Pi and now Hermes, configurable per profile, with no embedded credential (#239, #253, #261); every inference endpoint is gated on the per-key model allowlist (#255); the Antigravity lane sends the bare model id, because the effort suffix 404s every Gemini 3.8 request (#257); Gemini tool_call ids are made unique per occurrence so a long agent session can no longer 400 its whole history, and Ollama cache reads are recorded (#252); Qoder’s chat body is rewritten into Qoder’s own payload before signing — Closes #121 (#241); request-detail truncation no longer splits a UTF-8 rune, and pre-existing invalid bytes are scrubbed on write (#265, #268); provider artwork ships from upstream for muse, tinyfish and v1m, and the phantom header entries are gone from the catalog (#270); proxy pools get an actions menu, a status dropdown and a Netlify serverless relay pool (#260); six dashboard control rows collapse into menus and the API-key list renders as cards on a phone, with the dead language switcher removed (#235, #242, #244); every tag now posts its notes to the Telegram group (#221) and the changelog is assembled from per-PR fragments, so no release page needs a hand-written entry (#220).
